## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 252 reads during the quarter, recording 360 hours of work. This represents a rate of 0.7 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed against the expected reading activity for the period, with the volume and recorded hours considered together.

The review found that the work was distributed across the quarter and that the reported activity was sufficiently documented for assessment. No further information was requested in relation to the workload figures.

## Quality

A sample of 27 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was 81.5, indicating a generally consistent outcome across the material assessed. The review also considered how borderline background cases were handled, and feedback was provided where additional clarification would support consistency.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. Overall, the findings support the recorded workload and identify routine feedback for continued improvement in the handling of borderline cases.
